title: 第18章路劫
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
槐树镇外的路，比来时冷清得多。

    陈青山跟在那三个外门弟子后面走了一段，直到看见青云宗山门方向的界碑，才拱了拱手，拐进另一条小路。

    这条路近些。

    也更偏。

    换在平时，陈青山不会走，可现在身后若真有人盯着，跟在别人后头一路回宗门，反倒容易被人看出虚实。

    走出半里，他摸了摸怀里的金属片。

    隔着布，还是凉的。

    可识海里的造化鼎，一直轻轻震着。

    像饿极了的人，闻到了饭味。

    陈青山没敢停。

    这地方离坊市太近，不安全。

    又走了一刻钟，前面出现一片乱石坡。坡边长着几棵歪脖子松，下面是干沟，沟里积着枯叶和碎石。

    陈青山脚步慢了下来。

    太安静了。

    夜里有虫叫，有风声，可身后那点脚步声，隔一会儿就跟一下，不紧不慢，吊得很稳。

    他蹲下身，假装系鞋带，右手在袖口里摸了摸。

    三枚火针还在。

    另一个小纸包也在，里面是炼火针时剩下的炉灰和铁砂。

    不值钱。

    但撒进眼睛里，值命。

    “别装了。”

    身后传来一个沙哑声音。

    陈青山手指一顿。

    一个黑瘦汉子从松树后走出来，脸上戴着灰布面具，腰间挂一只铜钩，身上没有宗门道袍。

    散修。

    练气四层，或者更高一点。

    陈青山站起身，脸上挤出点怯意。

    “道友是不是认错人了？”

    “少废话。”

    灰布面具抬手，铜钩滑入掌心。

    “坊市里买的那块金属片，交出来。”

    果然。

    陈青山喉咙发干，眼角余光扫了一眼四周。

    乱石坡，干沟，歪脖子松。

    没别人。

    “那东西不值钱。”

    “不值钱你还花七十块灵石买？”

    灰布面具冷笑一声，往前走了两步。

    “东西留下，人可以走。”

    这话陈青山一个字都不信。

    他见过废器房里那些人怎么欺负弱的，也见过坊市任务榜上那张钓鱼纸条。

    这种时候交出东西，多半还是死。

    死人才不会告状。

    陈青山慢慢从怀里摸出一个小袋子。

    “这里还有十三块灵石，也给道友，只求道友放我一条路。”

    灰布面具看他这副模样，笑了。

    “倒是识相。”

    陈青山把小袋子扔过去。

    灰布面具伸手一接。

    就在袋子落入掌心的瞬间，里面一枚火针被灵力引动。
content_en:
The road outside Huaishu Town is much deserted than when we arrived.

    Chen Qingshan followed the three outer disciples for a while until he saw the boundary monument in the direction of the Qingyun Sect's mountain gate, then he cupped his hands and turned into another path.

    This road is closer.

    Also more biased.

    In normal times, Chen Qingshan would not leave, but now if someone is really watching behind him and follows others all the way back to the sect, it will be easy for others to see the truth.

    After walking half a mile, he touched the metal piece in his arms.

    Even through the cloth, it was still cold.

    The cauldron of creation in the visible sea has been vibrating gently.

    Like a very hungry person smelling the smell of rice.

    Chen Qingshan did not dare to stop.

    This place is too close to Fangshi and is unsafe.

    After walking for another quarter of an hour, a rocky slope appeared in front of us. There are several crooked-neck pine trees growing on the slope, and below is a dry ditch filled with dead leaves and gravel.

    Chen Qingshan's steps slowed down.

    It's so quiet.

    There were insects chirping and the wind blowing at night, but the footsteps behind me followed every now and then, unhurriedly and very steadily.

    He squatted down, pretended to tie his shoes, and touched his cuff with his right hand.

    The three fire needles are still there.

    Another small paper bag was also there, containing the ashes and iron sand left over from the fire needle refining process.

    Not worth the money.

    But if you sprinkle it into your eyes, it's worth your life.

    "Stop pretending."

    A hoarse voice came from behind.

    Chen Qingshan pointed his finger.

    A thin black man walked out from behind the pine tree. He wore a gray cloth mask on his face and a copper hook hanging on his waist. He did not have a sect robe on his body.

    Loose practice.

    Qi training level four, or a little higher.

    Chen Qingshan stood up with a hint of timidity on his face.

    "Did Fellow Taoist recognize the wrong person?"

    "Cut the nonsense."

    The gray cloth mask raised his hand, and the copper hook slid into his palm.

    "Hand over the piece of metal I bought in the market."

    Sure enough.

    Chen Qingshan's throat was dry and he glanced around from the corner of his eyes.

    Rocky slopes, dry ditches, and crooked neck pines.

    No one else.

    "That thing isn't worth anything."

    "You're still spending seventy spiritual stones to buy it if it's not worth anything?"

    The gray cloth mask sneered and took two steps forward.

    "Things stay and people can leave."

    Chen Qingshan didn’t believe a word of this.

    He had seen how those people in the waste equipment room bullied the weak, and he had also seen the fishing note on the city's task list.

    If you hand something over at this time, you will probably die.

    Only the dead will not complain.

    Chen Qingshan slowly took out a small bag from his arms.

    "There are still thirteen spiritual stones here, and they are also given to fellow Taoists. I just ask fellow Taoists to let me go."

    The gray cloth mask looked at his appearance and smiled.

    "It's a sign of recognition."

    Chen Qingshan threw the small bag over.

    The gray cloth mask reached out and took it.

    The moment the bag fell into the palm of his hand, a fire needle inside was activated by spiritual power.
